project_name.justification: The text states: "Big Gold Inc. ... is pleased to announce the acquisition of the Tabor Project ('Tabor' or the 'Project')..."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "Big Gold Inc. (CSE: BG) (the 'Company' or 'Big Gold')".

ceo_buyer.justification: The text identifies the CEO of the buyer, Big Gold Inc., in the signature line: "On Behalf of the Board of Directors, Scott Walters President and CEO".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The terms of the acquisition state: "Big Gold will issue 1,400,000 common shares of the Company and pay the Vendor $6,500 for a 100% interest in the Tabor Property..."

primary_commodity.justification: The text describes the project's mineralization: "Gold mineralization on the Project of roughly 3,120 hectares is reportedly associated with quartz veins, shearing and sulphides..."

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the acquisition of the Tabor project by Big Gold Inc. The source URL is provided at the end of the text: "To view the source version of this press release, please visit https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/161447"

currency.justification: The cash payment is denoted with a '$' symbol in the context of a Canadian company (Big Gold Inc.) listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE) acquiring a project in Ontario, Canada. The text states: "...pay the Vendor $6,500..."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The acquisition terms include a cash payment: "Under the terms of the Acquisition, Big Gold will ... pay the Vendor $6,500 for a 100% interest in the Tabor Property..."

share_payments_raw.justification: The text specifies the number of shares to be issued, but does not provide an explicit monetary value for this share component of the transaction.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the payment are listed separately, and no combined total value is provided in the text.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The acquisition terms specify the number of shares to be issued: "Under the terms of the Acquisition, Big Gold will issue 1,400,000 common shares of the Company..."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No mention of share warrants as part of the acquisition terms was found in the text.

option_payments_raw.justification: No mention of options as part of the acquisition terms was found in the text.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.02'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text mentions a '100,000 metre drill program' but this is for the adjacent Moss Gold Project, not an exploration commitment for the Tabor project.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No monetary exploration commitment for the Tabor project is mentioned in the text.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The acquisition is subject to a Net Smelter Royalty retained by the vendor: "...for a 100% interest in the Tabor Property, subject to a 2% NSR ('net smelter royalty')."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text specifies the size of the project area: "Gold mineralization on the Project of roughly 3,120 hectares..."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the project area is provided in the text: "Gold mineralization on the Project of roughly 3,120 hectares..."
